companies.description:
Role Overview We are seeking exceptional early-career software engineers who aspire to build the next generation of AI-native software platforms, reusable software IP and intelligent enterprise solutions. As an Elite Technology Engineer you will combine strong full-stack engineering foundations with AI-first development practices to create production-grade software, domain-specific AI capabilities and reusable engineering assets that power the future of enterprise technology. You will work on real client programmes across industries, designing and delivering AI-native applications using modern cloud platforms, AI-assisted development tools and software engineering best practices. Working alongside architects, product teams and AI specialists, you will help shape intelligent, scalable and continuously evolving software solutions. This role provides accelerated learning through structured AI certification pathways, exposure to leading AI ecosystems and hands-on experience developing reusable AI capabilities that create long-term client value.

companies.description:
Digital Consultants help clients solve business challenges through technology and enable large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working with organizations across various industries, digital consultants design, architect, and deliver technology-driven solutions that create measurable business value. As a Digital Consultant, you will: - Diagnose client business challenges and design enterprise architecture and digital solutions that deliver measurable outcomes - Lead the selection and design of cutting-edge technology solutions — Cloud, AI/Data Analytics, Industry X (Manufacturing Digitalization), IoT, XR, Customer Experience, and more — tailored to each client's strategic priorities - Translate complex technology possibilities into actionable business strategies, guiding clients from vision through to execution - Define what should be built — not just how to build it — leveraging AI and automation to enhance quality and accelerate delivery - Drive the full consulting lifecycle: problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation oversight, and value realization What sets Accenture apart: We are technology-agnostic, enabling us to always recommend the best solution for our clients — unconstrained by proprietary products. Our goal is not to ""build for the sake of building,"" but to ""transform and deliver results." You will start your career as an Analyst, developing both technology and consulting skills through hands-on project experience. As you gain experience, you can progress to Consultant and Manager and pursue a variety of career paths based on your interests, strengths, experience, and skills, including: Business × Technology Path: Leverage your engineering experience to expand into upstream areas such as requirements definition, IT planning and strategy, and solution design and proposals. Project Management Path: Develop your project management expertise and grow into a role that leads teams, large-scale projects, and programs. Technology Specialist Path: Deepen your expertise in specific technology areas and grow into roles such as a technology specialist or architect, leading projects from a technical perspective. Your career is not limited to a single path. As business demands evolve, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your areas of expertise — building a career that grows with both your strengths and the needs of your clients.

Job Description
Digital Consultants help clients solve business challenges through technology and enable large-scale digital transformation initiatives. Working with organizations across various industries, digital consultants design, architect, and deliver technology-driven solutions that create measurable business value. As a Digital Consultant, you will: - Diagnose client business challenges and design enterprise architecture and digital solutions that deliver measurable outcomes - Lead the selection and design of cutting-edge technology solutions — Cloud, AI/Data Analytics, Industry X (Manufacturing Digitalization), IoT, XR, Customer Experience, and more — tailored to each client's strategic priorities - Translate complex technology possibilities into actionable business strategies, guiding clients from vision through to execution - Define what should be built — not just how to build it — leveraging AI and automation to enhance quality and accelerate delivery - Drive the full consulting lifecycle: problem diagnosis, solution design, implementation oversight, and value realization What sets Accenture apart: We are technology-agnostic, enabling us to always recommend the best solution for our clients — unconstrained by proprietary products. Our goal is not to ""build for the sake of building,"" but to ""transform and deliver results." You will start your career as an Analyst, developing both technology and consulting skills through hands-on project experience. As you gain experience, you can progress to Consultant and Manager and pursue a variety of career paths based on your interests, strengths, experience, and skills, including: Business × Technology Path: Leverage your engineering experience to expand into upstream areas such as requirements definition, IT planning and strategy, and solution design and proposals. Project Management Path: Develop your project management expertise and grow into a role that leads teams, large-scale projects, and programs. Technology Specialist Path: Deepen your expertise in specific technology areas and grow into roles such as a technology specialist or architect, leading projects from a technical perspective. Your career is not limited to a single path. As business demands evolve, you will have the opportunity to develop new skills and expand your areas of expertise — building a career that grows with both your strengths and the needs of your clients.

About Accenture Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com. companies.description:
Airbus is building the future of aviation, and data is our engine. We are looking for passionate engineering students who want to bridge the gap between physical aerospace hardware and digital intelligence. In this role, you won’t just be coding; you will be applying data-driven insights to real-world industrial challenges—from analyzing sensor data to optimizing shopfloor processes. This involves both developing Data Foundations , AI models and industrializing these algorithms into functional software solutions that our teams can use daily. ● Your Mission : You will join a dynamic project focused on Industry 4.0. You will help us translate raw shopfloor signals into actionable data models and AI to help our engineers make smarter, faster decisions. Whether it’s standardizing data for robots or identifying patterns in manufacturing signals, your work will directly impact how we make it fly. Beyond modeling, you will bridge the gap between proof-of-concept and production, helping to develop and industrialize AI algorithms into usable software applications. ● Who You Are : You are a "Data-fluent" Engineer. You are eager to learn how to acquire Industrial operational Data from machines to build data foundations and industrialize algorithms into reliable software solutions. You have a logical mindset, a passion for industrial systems, and a curiosity about how Data Analytics can be applied to Shop Floor processes. Core Competencies (Must-Haves): ● A Logical Thinker: You enjoy breaking down complex problems into data-driven solutions. ● Proficient with Data Basics: You have hands-on with Python scripting (e.g., using Pandas or NumPy to clean/analyze data sets). ● Technically Curious: You understand that data is more than just numbers—it’s signals and time-series data from hardware and software. ● An Effective Communicator: You can explain your findings simply and document your process clearly for the team. ● Industrialization Mindset: Once the core modeling is done, you have the drive to progress those solutions into deployable software applications. ● Familiarity with Data structures ● Familiarity with AI/ML concepts (e.g., you’ve played with basic models in scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch).

The job requires defining, developing and deploying industrial systems in the frame of digital manufacturing and Industry 4.0. ● You will collaborate with industrial engineers for creating, delivering and standardizing discrete event simulation models of existing and future manufacturing Lines/Plants and FALs to balance production rate across processes, understand material flow, determine buffer requirements and maximize factory throughput ● You will be responsible for creating 3D Digital Mock-Ups of plants and prepare related methodology documentation and best practices to assist the Industrial teams from conceptual design through the finished industrial system. Additionally, assist in defining, developing and deploying these Industrial systems and digital twin capabilities ● You will secure the consideration of industrial aspects in the Aircraft definition, manage the design of the Industrial System in synchronization with the Aircraft design, increasing maturity throughout early development. It is applicable to all new Projects and Programs, including derivatives and major modifications of an existing Product/Program. ● You will be creating Industrial MBSE and related methodology documentation and best practices to assist the Industrial teams from conceptual design through the finished industrial system. ● You will work independently on the digital manufacturing tools and techniques on 3DExperience, for activities such as: Producing Routing , As-Prepared BoM, ISOI & Updating Work Order, Build Process and M-BOM definition. Preparing Work Instructions. ● You will be programming robotic systems and troubleshooting. Support Virtual commissioning activity across different Airbus Plant. Job Description
An Analyst will be working across the Corporate Finance and Investment Management teams. Analysts will work on company and industry research, business models, investment memos, information memoranda, valuation analyses, etc., and will support both teams on live mandates, prospects, and investment decisions. This is a full-time, work-from-office role based out of our Bangalore office. What You’ll Gain: Work in a boutique investment bank that has been consistently recognized as a leader in Healthcare & Life Sciences Investment Banking; close mentorship from experienced deal professionals.

About the company	Allegro Capital is a leader in healthcare and lifesciences investment banking. Established in Bangalore in 2002, the firm has advised promoters, corporates and global investors on mergers and acquisitions, private equity and growth capital fundraising, and strategic advisory transactions. Our corporate finance team has closed more than 125 deals with a combined value exceeding $23Bn and have advised market-leading companies like Manipal Hospitals, Biocon, Syngene, Narayana Hrudayalaya, Apollo Hospitals, Cloudnine, HCG, Indiabulls (not exhaustive) and globally renowned funds like KKR, TPG, IFC, TrueNorth (not exhaustive). companies.description:
At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since. Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well-recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart – a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world-class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Capital One is the 6 th largest US bank in consumer deposits, among the country’s top 5 Auto Lenders and a Fortune 500 company. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will apply strategic and analytical skills to major business challenges. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives

At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well-recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart – a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world-class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Capital One is the 6 th largest US bank in consumer deposits, among the country’s top 5 Auto Lenders and a Fortune 500 company. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will apply strategic and analytical skills to major business challenges. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives

Job Description
At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making. Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. Visit our website to learn more about who we are and what we do! At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business - including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more - from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale. Capital One is looking for business analysts to drive our foray into autonomous and intelligent data products that solve the full gamut of business and analytical needs. The role will be part of an exceptional team that is drawn from elite campuses in India and abroad and focused on our mission to develop world class data products. At Capital One, you will work in a fast paced and intellectually rigorous environment. You will have the opportunity to learn and build deep expertise in the core areas of advanced analytics, industrial-scale product design and development, data science and machine learning. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values problem solving, encourages creativity, promotes learning, and rewards innovation. Capital One prides itself on its exceptionally vibrant culture. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared values, come together to make Capital One a great company and a great place to work. Our Associate Development program enables us to shape amazing career and professional development opportunities for our associates. Our best-in-class Corporate Social Responsibility program has nurtured longstanding partnerships with committed organizations that make a meaningful difference to the communities around us. The enthusiastic volunteerism of our associates is the backbone of all that we do - it enables us to push the envelope of possibilities and have incredible fun along the way. We bend backwards to take care of one another through thick and thin. Our work and the people we are surrounded by are an enduring source of strength and fulfillment in our lives.

Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things. As an organization, CBA has been consistently voted as the Best Place to Work and Best Workplace to Grow Your Career by LinkedIn, Australian Financial Review and other renowned entities. For its cutting edge research and innovation and maturity in using Artificial Intelligence, CBA is named the #1 Asia Pacific bank and ranked 6th globally in the Evident AI Index for banks (https://www.evidentinsights.com/ai-index/), a global standard benchmark of Artificial Intelligence (AI) maturity. You can communicate clearly and effectively, even the most complex of ideas and thoughts. You have a strong online presence, through blogposts or participation in competitions or paper publications. companies.description:
About the role: As a graduate in Deutsche Bank, you will have the opportunity to work with teams supporting the Bank's Investment Banking business globally and learn about banking from different viewpoints, which will give you a career advantage. As a graduate, your work may include: Connecting and working with global teams within the Investment Bank, and interacting with bankers, traders, and structurers in different regions across the world. Developing a strong grasp of ongoing macro events and their impact on various asset classes. Undertaking in-depth analysis of companies, sectors, and transactions, including due diligence and financial modelling of companies, industry analysis, quantitative and technical analysis, benchmarking, or supporting the execution of deals and flow trades. Developing a holistic view of the business, including the DB product suite, its operational markets, and applicable regulations. Based on this, creating marketing content related to deal pitches, new trades executed, DB capability expansion, regulatory changes, etc. Areas in which you can work: Origination & Advisory Industry Coverage (e.g., Industrials, Healthcare, TMT, etc.) Product Coverage (e.g., M&A, Ratings Advisory, Equity & Debt Capital Markets, etc.) What we look for: We recruit graduates who are intelligent and adaptable, with excellent interpersonal skills. They have degrees in many different disciplines. Even though good levels of numeracy are important for some roles, you will not necessarily need a formal mathematical or financial background. We have very comprehensive training programmes that will give you all the technical knowledge you'll need to build a career with us. To be eligible for the 2026 Graduate Programme, you must: Complete your studies (all final exams and coursework) and have no outstanding requirements for graduation by July 2026. Be able to start full-time work in July 2026, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.

Team offers clients with Business Model Reinvention, New Market Entry Opportunities and Digital Strategy and Innovation Your key responsibilities • Understand client issues and assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them • Assist team with commercial due diligence which is to analyze market dynamics including the size and growth of an industry as well as the individual target’s positioning, potential growth levers, risks, and opportunities • Assist with new strategy formulation which includes evaluating opportunities for growth including entering new geographies, offering new products and services, or serving new customer segments • Assist with solutions revolving around Digital Strategy and Innovation by assessing the clients underlying digital business models, explore avenues for new growth, both organically and inorganically, and construct the roadmap to build, grow and transform the organization for the digital world • Offering Go to Market Strategy by identifying opportunities to improve how products and services reach customers including but not limited to decisions related to route-to-market, channel selection, pricing optimization, and customer segmentation • Assisting Transaction integration services by deploying a holistic integration program that addresses topics such as people, value, control, execution and technology is imperative • Assist the project team to in help clients improve portfolio management, divestment strategy and execution FY 2025 2 • Also assist the project team in pre deal analysis and Due Diligence by synergy identification, validation, planning and delivery tracking. Job Description
The opportunity EY Parthenon is looking for a suitable member for our team in Strategy practice. The role provides an opportunity to be part of the team which assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them, analyse industry dynamics such as market size, growth, and share of leading competitors, identify the business’ unique competitive advant age and help create alignment among all business units and functions to support and en hance this positioning. Team offers clients with Business Model Reinvention, New Market Entry Opportunities and Digital Strategy and Innovation Your key responsibilities • Understand client issues and assist businesses in setting strategic goals and identifying the steps to meet them • Assist team with commercial due diligence which is to analyze market dynamics including the size and growth of an industry as well as the individual target’s positioning, potential growth levers, risks, and opportunities • Assist with new strategy formulation which includes evaluating opportunities for growth including entering new geographies, offering new products and services, or serving new customer segments • Assist with solutions revolving around Digital Strategy and Innovation by assessing the clients underlying digital business models, explore avenues for new growth, both organically and inorganically, and construct the roadmap to build, grow and transform the organization for the digital world • Offering Go to Market Strategy by identifying opportunities to improve how products and services reach customers including but not limited to decisions related to route-to-market, channel selection, pricing optimization, and customer segmentation • Assisting Transaction integration services by deploying a holistic integration program that addresses topics such as people, value, control, execution and technology is imperative • Assist the project team to in help clients improve portfolio management, divestment strategy and execution FY 2025 2 • Also assist the project team in pre deal analysis and Due Diligence by synergy identification, validation, planning and delivery tracking. Also focusing on operational due diligence and IT due diligence • Responsible for a specific workstream in the project • Responsible for contributing towards knowledge sharing portals to build the practices intellectual property Skills and attributes for success • Demonstrated ability to deliver on complex assignments • Experience in delivering business strategy and diligence projects in complex environments • Strong quantitative skills for data analysis, interpretation of output, and generation of insights • Research oriented mindset • Should have an eye for detail • Ability to flex individual styles and work back with diverse teams • Strong communication skills – oral and written (in terms of making presentation) • Strong financial modelling skills and clarity of financial concepts • Desire to contribute and succeed in a fun, exciting, collegial, and challenging environment • Proficient in the English language both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment • Willingness and ability to travel To qualify for the role, you must have • Engineering graduates (from premier institute) with a good academic background Ideally, you’ll also have • Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills. • Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative. • Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client) • Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility. What we look for People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

companies.description:
The AI Solutions Org is a new, high-velocity engineering unit at Flipkart with a singular mission: to accelerate AI adoption across the entire company. Will operate as a "SWAT team" for AI - building end-to-end solutions for business functions that lack engineering bandwidth, while also partnering with the core Data Science team to optimize and scale state-of-the-art models (FK LLMs, Open Source, Commercial). This is not a traditional software engineering role. We believe the future of coding is AI-assisted. You are expected to be an AI-Native Engineer: ● You don't just write code; you orchestrate it. You leverage tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and LLMs to write code, generate test cases, debug, and perform RCAs at 10x speed. ● You are Full-Stack + AI. You are comfortable setting up a backend API, building a quick UI, and engineering a complex RAG pipeline in the same sprint. You'll be responsible for: 1. End-to-End AI Feature Development: Write clean, efficient code using AI coding assistants to build, test, and own full AI features from concept to release. 2. LLM Integration & RAG Pipelines: Implement LLM API integrations, craft effective prompts, construct E2E RAG architecture using Vector DBs and embeddings, analyze commercial vs. open-source models for cost and performance. 3. Architecture, Deployment & Performance: Design mid-sized AI application architectures, deploy services via Docker/K8s or internal platforms, optimize inference latency, and assist Data Science teams with basic fine-tuning. 4. AI Native Operations & Engineering Mentorship: Use AI tools for automated unit testing, documentation, and production root cause analysis.

companies.description:
About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Job Description
About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Mountain View/ San Francisco, US Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Job Description
About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform.With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee.This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time.The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for Software Engineers to build highly performant, scalable, secure, permissions-aware systems that make all the relevant enterprise knowledge readily available to employees in all contexts of their work. As an early-career engineer, you will join a team working on a core part of the Glean product and learn from experienced engineers while shipping real, customer-facing impact from early on. The role offers ample opportunities to work across the stack of a modern cloud-native, AI-first application. You could work on areas such as: Infrastructure & Platform: building scalable, reliable distributed systems and underlying storage, deployment and monitoring tooling, and the cloud-native foundations that let us run across multiple cloud environments while balancing performance and cost Search & Knowledge: building the connectors, indexing pipelines, data models and ranking/retrieval systems that make diverse enterprise sources searchable, with a laser focus on making the experience feel instant and relevant Assistant & Agents: building the AI Assistant and agentic capabilities (including LLM-powered workflows, tool use, and agent orchestration) that answer questions and automate real work across the enterprise Protect & Security: working on end-to-end security and governance - permissions-aware access, data protection, and application layer, platform layer and IT security - so enterprises can trust Glean with their most sensitive knowledge Product & Application Engineering: building intuitive, high-quality front-end and full-stack experiences across web, browser extensions, and integrations in the tools where people already work You will: Own well-scoped problems from design and implementation through to production launch, taking on increasing scope over time Write clear design documents and robust, high-quality, well-tested code Work collaboratively with a strong team to identify the most impactful projects we should be prioritizing in our roadmap Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews, mentorship and hands-on collaboration, and grow quickly into a high-ownership engineer About you: BA/BS/B.Tech/M.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related degree, graduating in 2027 Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases and computer networks Strong coding skills (for example in Go/Python/Java/C++ etc), with an emphasis on writing clean, reliable and well-tested code; relevant internships, projects, open-source contributions or competitive programming experience are a plus Thrive in a customer-focused, tight-knit and cross-functional environment - being a team player and willing to take on whatever is most impactful for the company is a must A proactive and positive attitude to lead, learn, troubleshoot and take ownership of both small tasks and large features Curiosity about AI/LLMs, search, distributed systems or security, and a desire to build in these areas Familiarity with cloud native development practices in GCP/AWS/Azure is a plus Location: · This role is in person in Bangalore, India Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today, prior Glean experience isn't required.

Job Description
Software Engineer I – Campus Hiring Role Join Harness as a Software Engineer I and work on building scalable, reliable software across areas such as CI/CD, Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, Developer Experience, and AI-powered software delivery. You will work closely with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software. Eligibility B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering disciplines. Fresh graduates graduating in 2027. Strong academic and technical fundamentals. Eligible candidates as per the campus-specific placement criteria. Skills Strong understanding of Data Structures & Algorithms. Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming. Proficiency in at least one programming language: Java, C++, Go, or Python. Understanding of DBMS, Operating Systems, and Computer Networks. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good communication and collaboration skills. Familiarity with Git, Linux, REST APIs, cloud technologies, or CI/CD is a plus. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software. Build scalable and reliable products and services. Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code. Debug and troubleshoot technical issues. Participate in code reviews and engineering discussions. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and other cross-functional teams. Learn and contribute to Harness technologies, tools, and engineering practices.

This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. Job Description
Scope: We are seeking top tier Cloud Native DevOps Platform Engineers to augment our Data Platform team. This role requires a breadth of individual technical capabilities and competencies, though, most important, is a willingness and openness to learn new things across multiple technology disciplines. This role is for practitioners and not researchers. Based in Gurugram, you will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You will drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. As a Platform Engineer you will have the opportunity to: Work alongside our system engineers and UI developers to help design and build scalable, automated CI/CD pipelines. Help prove out and productionize infrastructure and tooling to support scalable cloud-based applications. Work/Unlock myriad generative AI/ML use cases for Data Strategy Group and thus for HL. Have fun as part of an awesome team. Responsibilities: Platform Ownership Develop, implement, and operate a robust internal platform (Kubernetes-based) enabling self-service deployments, scalable workloads, and standardized guardrails. Contribute to the development and enhancement of CI/CD workflows and automation solutions using GitLab or GitHub Cloud Engineering Design secure and cost-aware cloud topologies (networking, IAM, compute, storage, serverless, managed DBs, and edge/CDN). Collaborate with the platform engineering team to implement and operate Kubernetes-native capabilities such as service networking, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions. Observability & Reliability Establish end-to-end telemetry with OpenTelemetry; define SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and incident response runbooks. Developer Experience Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation. Data Operations and Engineering Support database or datastores e.g. MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Ignite, Hadoop, S3, Azure Blob Store; and various messaging and streaming platforms such as NATS or Kafka Gain hands-on experience in developing Python-based solutions for data acquisition, processing, and ETL/ELT workflows. Basic Qualifications & Experience required: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferrable computer science. Exposure to cloud technologies through academic projects, internships, certifications, hackathons, or self-learning is preferred. Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang. Knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating Systems. Strong communication skills (written & verbal) in English.

Job Role: Associate (Consulting) Experience: Fresher CTC: ₹32.1 LPA (detailed breakup below) Location: Gurgaon, Haryana Website: www.indusinsights.com About Us Indus Insights is a VC-funded, ISO-27001 certified, specialized management consulting firm focused on the Financial Services. Our leaders are quoted by leading global publications such as Forbes, CIO magazine, VentureBeat, Fox Business, Information Week, etc. This is a front-end opportunity which will allow you to use Analytics & Machine Learning to address some of the most exciting problems in fintech, banking & digital sectors while directly liaising with CEOs, CMOs, CROs, and Heads of P&L. You will have unparalleled, complete ownership of your projects. Why Indus? • Fast moving organization for someone who is keen to climb an exponential growth trajectory • Exposure to multi-faceted projects, helping you gain deep insights into various businesses • A rigorous on-the-job training regimen that trains you in critical analytical and programming skills (Python, SQL, R, Tableau) from the ground-up, with no prerequisites • A bright, driven, & extremely talented team of colleagues • Cutting-edge work wherein data science meets Fintech and Insurtech with a presence across multiple countries • A strong ethic of employee centricity that invests heavily in holistic professional development of every individual If you like the overlap of business, math, and technology, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, this role is tailor-made for you! More Details: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLvmkiysf10Hg3tXNw8Sh3HrISEobBkt4a&feature=shared Roles and Responsibilities 1. Drive analytics projects for our clients a. Translate broad business problems into clear, coherent frameworks b. Deploy a complex toolkit a of problem-solving approaches, participate in brainstorming sessions with the team c. Manipulate, merge, and create hygienic datasets from a variety of sources; be the subject-matter expert on client data and trends d. Use advanced statistical techniques (regression, machine learning) to create predictive algorithms, economic valuation models, perform impact sizing, stress testing. Evaluate their performance and finetune them to suit business needs e. Combine insights from data and deep business understanding to create business cases and sharing recommendations with CXOs 2. Client and Project Management a. Work directly with client maps to understand the business context and data trends b. Partner with them to address data issues and ensure consistency between data trends and actual business performance c. Present findings, updates, and recommendations to clients on a periodic basis d. Ensure smooth delivery of the project, provide periodic updates to Indus leadership & to clients, highlight roadblocks, etc. 3. Other Activities a. Be involved in hiring activities of Indus b. Lead internal workstreams, such as internal R&D projects, business development assistance, lead new joining training sessions, etc. Sample Business Problems Addressed We develop sophisticated predictive models & machine learning algorithms for our clients, and act as their extended teams for ongoing analytical needs. Our focus is the financial services sector, where we add value in marketing analytics, customer management analytics (churn, lifetime value modelling, next-best-offer, etc), and analytics in credit risk, pricing collections & fraud areas. 1. Reducing cost of operating airlines by creating accurate and optimized schedules 2. Reducing losses for lending firms by creating machine learning-based models to identify high risk borrowers 3. Increasing marketing effectiveness by targeting customers likely to use the credit card being offered Key Expectations 1. Professional Qualifications Eligible courses: a. B. Tech, M. Tech and Dual Degree courses 2. Competencies a. A curious person with a drive to solve business problems and being solution oriented b. Someone with an entrepreneurial mindset & humility c. Be inclined to be a part of high growth company d. Highly collaborative in nature and drive excellent relationships e. Job Description
Job Role: Associate (Consulting) Experience: Fresher CTC: ₹32.1 LPA (detailed breakup below) Location: Gurgaon, Haryana Website: www.indusinsights.com About Us Indus Insights is a VC-funded, ISO-27001 certified, specialized management consulting firm focused on the Financial Services. Our leaders are quoted by leading global publications such as Forbes, CIO magazine, VentureBeat, Fox Business, Information Week, etc. This is a front-end opportunity which will allow you to use Analytics & Machine Learning to address some of the most exciting problems in fintech, banking & digital sectors while directly liaising with CEOs, CMOs, CROs, and Heads of P&L. You will have unparalleled, complete ownership of your projects. Why Indus? • Fast moving organization for someone who is keen to climb an exponential growth trajectory • Exposure to multi-faceted projects, helping you gain deep insights into various businesses • A rigorous on-the-job training regimen that trains you in critical analytical and programming skills (Python, SQL, R, Tableau) from the ground-up, with no prerequisites • A bright, driven, & extremely talented team of colleagues • Cutting-edge work wherein data science meets Fintech and Insurtech with a presence across multiple countries • A strong ethic of employee centricity that invests heavily in holistic professional development of every individual If you like the overlap of business, math, and technology, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, this role is tailor-made for you! More Details: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLvmkiysf10Hg3tXNw8Sh3HrISEobBkt4a&feature=shared Roles and Responsibilities 1. Drive analytics projects for our clients a. Translate broad business problems into clear, coherent frameworks b. Deploy a complex toolkit a of problem-solving approaches, participate in brainstorming sessions with the team c. Manipulate, merge, and create hygienic datasets from a variety of sources; be the subject-matter expert on client data and trends d. Use advanced statistical techniques (regression, machine learning) to create predictive algorithms, economic valuation models, perform impact sizing, stress testing. Evaluate their performance and finetune them to suit business needs e. Combine insights from data and deep business understanding to create business cases and sharing recommendations with CXOs 2. Client and Project Management a. Work directly with client maps to understand the business context and data trends b. Partner with them to address data issues and ensure consistency between data trends and actual business performance c. Present findings, updates, and recommendations to clients on a periodic basis d. Ensure smooth delivery of the project, provide periodic updates to Indus leadership & to clients, highlight roadblocks, etc. 3. Other Activities a. Be involved in hiring activities of Indus b. Lead internal workstreams, such as internal R&D projects, business development assistance, lead new joining training sessions, etc. Sample Business Problems Addressed We develop sophisticated predictive models & machine learning algorithms for our clients, and act as their extended teams for ongoing analytical needs. Our focus is the financial services sector, where we add value in marketing analytics, customer management analytics (churn, lifetime value modelling, next-best-offer, etc), and analytics in credit risk, pricing collections & fraud areas. 1. Reducing cost of operating airlines by creating accurate and optimized schedules 2. Reducing losses for lending firms by creating machine learning-based models to identify high risk borrowers 3. Increasing marketing effectiveness by targeting customers likely to use the credit card being offered Key Expectations 1. Professional Qualifications Eligible courses: a. B. Tech, M. Tech and Dual Degree courses 2. Competencies a. A curious person with a drive to solve business problems and being solution oriented b. Someone with an entrepreneurial mindset & humility c. Be inclined to be a part of high growth company d. Highly collaborative in nature and drive excellent relationships e. Demonstrate ability to manage/interact with global stakeholders (internal & external) Recruitment Process • Stage 1: Aptitude Test • Stage 2: Case Workshop + Buddy Program • Stage 3: Final Interviews CTC Breakup 1. Base: 21 Lakhs 2. Joining Bonus: 1 Lakh (Paid with first-month salary) 3. Variable: up to 3.15 Lakhs (10% of Base; Performance-Based) 4. LTIP: up to 6.3 lakhs 5. Gratuity: 35K 6. Health Insurance: 22K 7. Total Compensation: 32.1 LPA

InMobi has also built a second unicorn, Glance, which is advancing digital consumption and creating a new wave of disruption. Glance: Founded in 2019, Glance is a consumer technology company that operates some of the most disruptive digital platforms including Glance, Roposo, and Glance TV. Glance has redefined the way the internet is consumed on the lock screen, removing the need to search for and download apps. Over 400 million smartphones now come enabled with Glance’s next-generation internet experience.     Roposo has revolutionized commerce by launching a destination for creator-led live entertainment commerce. Glance TV is changing the way consumers engage and interact with their televisions.     Headquartered in Singapore, Glance is an unconsolidated subsidiary of InMobi Group and is funded by Jio Platforms, Google, and Mithril Capital. companies.description:
This position is for a Mixed-Signal engineer who can be trained to eventually lead some of our Analog/Mixed-Signal IC tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Mixed-Signal engineer who can be trained to eventually lead some of our Analog/Mixed-Signal IC tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

Job Description
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

companies.description:
Embedded Software: Build the firmware that powers next-gen wearables using ultra-low-energy Wi-R wireless technology. �� On‑site – Bengaluru, India | Competitive salary + bonus + early equity ��About Ixana Ixana is a Purdue University spinoff pioneering brain-inspired wearable computing. We've developed Wi-R, a patented communication tech that's 100x more energy-efficient than Bluetooth or WiFi. Join our 60-person team building the next era of real-time, AI-powered human-computer interaction. �� The Wi-R Revolution Wi-R is our patented non-radiative near-field communication technology that creates secure "wire-like wireless" experiences through small E-field bubbles around your body. This breakthrough enables unprecedented energy efficiency at sub-0.1 nanojoules per bit, making long-term wearable and implantable devices finally practical. See Wi-R in action: Visit ixana.ai for demos of high-speed data streaming through skin contact: https://vimeo.com/ixana/pairing-contact-transfer What You’ll Do Write bare-metal C/C++ firmware to interface MCUs with sensors and Wi-R chips. Lead embedded software development for Wi-R reference devices like smartglasses, smartwatches, earbuds, EEG/EMG nodes, and more. Build, test, and debug low level embedded code on custom hardware platforms. Integrate and optimize communication protocols (I2C, SPI, BLE) for wearable use cases. Work closely with hardware and system engineers to iterate on design and bring-up. Help shape and contribute to the new Wi-R embedded software standard. What We're Looking For One of the following must be true: experience writing embedded code for wearable or silicon chip bring-up. Strong experience with MCU firmware development. Low-level coding ability (bare-metal, register-level) and ow-power optimization skills. Familiarity with interfaces like I2C, SPI, BLE, and hands-on debugging. Preferred Qualifications Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and embedded debugging tools. Familiarity with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB. Exposure to personal embedded projects or hardware hacking. PCB design or firmware–hardware co-design experience. Experience working with toolchains, makefiles, and custom build environments. �� Compensation & Benefits • Base salary: Competitive and based on experience • Cash bonus + meaningful early‑stage equity • Relocation bonus, partner job‑search help • Medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, inventor cash awards �� Why Join Us Work on deep tech that matters Collaborate with world-class experts and industry leaders Own your work end-to-end and see real impact Enjoy a culture of speed, rigor, and respect Competitive salary, equity, and global exposure �� Location On-site — Bengaluru, India (Brookefield Mall area). Multiple openings available across experience levels — from fresh graduates to 10+ years of industry experience. ��Application Requirements Resume (Optional) Personal embedded projects or GitHub links Short write-up on an embedded system you've built or contributed to Ready to re‑wire the future of human-computer interaction? Apply via our careers page. In your note, tell us how you envision using Wi‑R to transform everyday experiences—across healthcare, industry, or consumer tech. Ixana is an equal opportunity employer committed to advancing human-computer interfaces through innovative low-power electronics innovation. Keywords: Embedded Systems, Wearables, C/C++, MCU Firmware, Bare Metal, Low-Power Design, Wi-R, Startup, Equity, I2C, SPI, BLE, Embedded Debugging
