Embedded Software: Build the firmware that powers next-gen wearables using ultra-low-energy Wi-R wireless technology. �� On‑site – Bengaluru, India | Competitive salary + bonus + early equity ��About Ixana Ixana is a Purdue University spinoff pioneering brain-inspired wearable computing. We've developed Wi-R, a patented communication tech that's 100x more energy-efficient than Bluetooth or WiFi. Join our 60-person team building the next era of real-time, AI-powered human-computer interaction. �� The Wi-R Revolution Wi-R is our patented non-radiative near-field communication technology that creates secure "wire-like wireless" experiences through small E-field bubbles around your body. This breakthrough enables unprecedented energy efficiency at sub-0.1 nanojoules per bit, making long-term wearable and implantable devices finally practical. See Wi-R in action: Visit ixana.ai for demos of high-speed data streaming through skin contact: https://vimeo.com/ixana/pairing-contact-transfer What You’ll Do Write bare-metal C/C++ firmware to interface MCUs with sensors and Wi-R chips. Lead embedded software development for Wi-R reference devices like smartglasses, smartwatches, earbuds, EEG/EMG nodes, and more. Build, test, and debug low level embedded code on custom hardware platforms. Integrate and optimize communication protocols (I2C, SPI, BLE) for wearable use cases. Work closely with hardware and system engineers to iterate on design and bring-up. Help shape and contribute to the new Wi-R embedded software standard. What We're Looking For One of the following must be true: experience writing embedded code for wearable or silicon chip bring-up. Strong experience with MCU firmware development. Low-level coding ability (bare-metal, register-level) and ow-power optimization skills. Familiarity with interfaces like I2C, SPI, BLE, and hands-on debugging. Preferred Qualifications Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and embedded debugging tools. Familiarity with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB. Exposure to personal embedded projects or hardware hacking. PCB design or firmware–hardware co-design experience. Experience working with toolchains, makefiles, and custom build environments. �� Compensation & Benefits • Base salary: Competitive and based on experience • Cash bonus + meaningful early‑stage equity • Relocation bonus, partner job‑search help • Medical, dental, vision, generous PTO, inventor cash awards �� Why Join Us Work on deep tech that matters Collaborate with world-class experts and industry leaders Own your work end-to-end and see real impact Enjoy a culture of speed, rigor, and respect Competitive salary, equity, and global exposure �� Location On-site — Bengaluru, India (Brookefield Mall area). Multiple openings available across experience levels — from fresh graduates to 10+ years of industry experience. ��Application Requirements Resume (Optional) Personal embedded projects or GitHub links Short write-up on an embedded system you've built or contributed to Ready to re‑wire the future of human-computer interaction? Apply via our careers page. In your note, tell us how you envision using Wi‑R to transform everyday experiences—across healthcare, industry, or consumer tech. Ixana is an equal opportunity employer committed to advancing human-computer interfaces through innovative low-power electronics innovation. PLACEMENT	IC Design Engineer III	4550000 INR
Job Description
This position is for a Analog/Digital engineer who can be trained to own blocks in our chip tapeouts. You will work with a team of engineers designing IPs for advanced communications SOCs. These chips integrate complete PHY and MAC layers (including RF/analog circuits, digital ASIC, and CPU subsystems) on a single die, and are being designed in deep-submicron CMOS processes for use in next-generation wireless systems with 100X lower power than BLE. Working in a fast-growing startup will offer you an oversight of the entire product development cycle, while fully challenging your ability to develop complex analog & mixed-signal solutions for a completely new communication protocol that has 100X lower power than Bluetooth, and collaborating closely with other engineering teams to make the overall product successful.

companies.description:
Full-Time | Core Team | Bengaluru LAT Aerospace | Civil, Defence & GTE At LAT Aerospace, we're solving critical aerospace problems in India, for the world, across three programs: regional mobility through short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft, aircraft and drone propulsion through indigenous gas turbine engines, and securing our borders with cutting-edge autonomy and tech aiding our armed forces. We're hiring graduate engineers who want to own a subsystem, not shadow one - pick a problem below and work on it directly inside one of our programs. What you'll work on Aerodynamics - CFD and low-fidelity simulations of blown wing aerodynamics, and flight dynamic models for advanced wing configurations to support STOL constraints GNC - Low-speed control of our aircraft using the distributed propulsion architecture; software and hardware-in-loop simulations to validate control logic Structures - Design, FEA, and testing loops for primary and secondary aircraft structures; integrating powertrain, stacked electric ducted fans, and other components into a reliable airframe Powertrain - Power electronics, controls, thermals, and integration of our hybrid-electric powertrain Gas Turbine Engine - Compressor, combustion chamber, turbines, materials, manufacturing, and FADEC control Autonomy and Defence - CUAS radar, interceptor drones, navigation computers, GNSS-denied operation What we're looking for High action bias - a "getting things done" attitude and confidence tackling varied, tough technical challenges Real depth in at least one of: aerodynamics, structures, GNC, powertrain, turbomachinery, autonomy, electronics. Depth in one beats a shallow pass over all six Evidence that you build things - FSAE, Aero Design, rocketry, hyperloop, UAV or robotics teams, published work, a strong BTP, or a serious personal build. What you did matters more than the team's ranking Comfort with ambiguity - incomplete requirements, changing designs, and decisions made with imperfect data should sound interesting, not alarming Why LAT? Core team opportunity at a high-conviction deep-tech startup Real aircraft, real flying hardware, real impact Ownership from day one - your own analyses, your own components, one desk away from the people making the biggest calls Build the future of sustainable aviation in a secure India

About the company	Imagine a world where flying is as easy as taking a bus – where air travel isn't reserved for major cities, but reaches everyone, everywhere. No congested hubs, no security lines, no hours lost in transit. Just seamless, affordable, on-demand flights connecting thousands of destinations the world has overlooked for too long. We're building the future of mass aviation: a network of high-frequency, low-cost, 8-seater STOL (short take-off and landing) aircraft that make every city, town, and community accessible. Our aircraft take off and land from compact "air-stops" no bigger than a parking lot – no baggage belts, no bottlenecks, none of the expensive airport infrastructure that regional travel was never meant to need. But easy flight is the outcome of hard engineering – and that engineering doesn't stop at the airframe. The engine that powers it, the autonomy that flies it, the systems that defend it are all the same problem. So we're building three capabilities India should own itself: Civil: an 8-seater hybrid-electric STOL aircraft, designed ground-up for efficiency and built for affordability. Gas Turbine Engines: world-class gas turbine engines developed in-house, laying the foundations of a true aerospace ecosystem. Defence: sovereign autonomy and defence systems that perceive, decide, and act in the real world. Aerodynamics from first principles. Propulsion built in-house. Autonomy from day one. This isn't the supersonic fantasy you've been sold. It's the aviation our communities actually need.

About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

Job Description
About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Work with product, tech, and analytics to scale India's largest marketplace toward 1Bn+ users and 10M+ sellers. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. (kept as-is — this is your existing track definition and already matches the BU) Financial Services Build and scale Meesho's lending business — Paylater, personal loans, and SME credit — to become India's most trusted financial partner for the masses. Design credit and risk models that unlock formal credit for millions of underserved sellers and users, many for the first time. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. AI Services (MAS) Build AI agents that reimagine manual, people-heavy business processes — starting with contact center services for enterprise clients. Own end-to-end client outcomes — taking full accountability for resolution across voice, chat, and workflow automation. Work at the frontier of India's AI-services wave across 10+ languages, always-on, building the playbook rather than inheriting one. Grocery Build the lowest-cost grocery supply chain in India, unbundling costs and unlocking latent supply to win on price. Design and test category, pricing, and network innovations (like the drop-point model) to make grocery structurally cheaper than every other player, online or offline. Scale Meesho Grocery from an early bet into India's first true e-grocery marketplace, working across category, fulfillment, and tech. Compensation & Perks Total CTC: ₹36 LPA Fixed Pay: ₹15.30 L Variable: ₹2.7 L Joining Bonus (at the time of joining): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 1): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 2): ₹3 L Retention Bonus (end of year 3): ₹4 L Retention Bonus (end of year 4): ₹5 L Perks You'll Love: 🧠 Exposure to leaders & steep learning curve ✨ Impact from Day 1 in one of India's fastest-growing startups 🏆 Performance-based growth & ownership 🍕 Food, fun, and vibrant office spaces Why Meesho? Because we're not building a company. We're building a movement. Because we don't care where you come from – we care where you're headed. Because here, your ideas don't need ten approvals — just tenacity. Because at Meesho, you're not just joining a job — you're launching your entrepreneurial journey. Ready to reimagine Bharat with us? Apply now. Dream big. Hustle hard. Win together.

About the company	Meesho is India’s e-commerce marketplace, on a mission to democratise internet commerce. Our multi-sided technology platform connects four key stakeholders — consumers, sellers, logistics partners, and content creators — to power inclusive growth at scale. Job Description
About Meesho Meesho started with a bold idea - to make internet commerce accessible to every Indian, everywhere. A decade later, we've grown into India's largest horizontal e-commerce platform for the next billion users - but the mission hasn't changed: Democratize internet commerce for everyone. Our name - Meri Shop - reflects who we build for: the small business owner in Bharat. Whether it's a saree seller in Surat, a reseller in Ranchi, or a first-time shopper in a Tier-3 town - we're their platform of choice. We've helped millions of sellers to go online, with zero commission, lowest logistics cost, and a deeply localized, relatable assortment that mirrors how India shops. But we're more than just an app - we're a culture of first principles thinking, humility, and high ownership. We've built a company that moves fast, thinks long-term, and empowers people to take big bets early in their careers. Our 10-year journey has been one of experimentation, pivots, resilience, and impact. From being India's top reseller platform to becoming the first Indian e-commerce company to turn profitable, we've done what few thought was possible - all while keeping our users and sellers at the heart of every decision. So if you're looking to build for Bharat, solve complex problems at scale, and be part of a team that values courage over convention - Meesho is the place for you. About the Role: Senior Associate – Business Management Track This is not your average entry-level job. As a Senior Associate, you'll be thrown into the deep end from Day 1. You'll get end-to-end exposure to solving 10x problems, owning business charters, working with CXOs, and shaping strategies that directly impact millions of users and sellers across India. You'll join one of our core business verticals, working in small, high-impact teams. You'll solve real business challenges, use data like second nature, and move at the speed of a startup. With AI as a force multiplier, expect your individual ownership to expand well beyond a traditional job title - you'll increasingly get to own outcomes end-to-end, not just a narrow slice of the problem, with the flexibility to grow deeper into business or lean into product as you go. What You'll Work On You'll be mapped to one of the following tracks based on your interest and business needs: Commerce Platform Own the core marketplace flywheel — driving user acquisition, activation, and retention while strengthening the seller ecosystem and expanding categories and selection. Shape strategies across discovery, pricing, and monetization to make Meesho the most affordable, personalized shopping destination for Bharat. Make Meesho a trusted shopping destination through competitive pricing, a reliable marketplace, and a differentiated branded experience on Mall. Power content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven journeys that improve engagement, trust, and conversion. Fulfilment & Experience Empower every seller with a zero-loss, friction-free & predictable operating system. Enable a trusted channel for users to buy without hesitation through faster delivery timelines, seamless delivery experience, and support through the post-order journey. Work with product, tech, and ops teams to build the lowest-cost, reliable & efficient supply chain that enables selling everything on Meesho. Partner with product, tech, and analytics teams to grow lending AUM from ₹250 Cr today toward ₹20,000 Cr by 2030. Associate Product Manager I Location: Bengaluru About the Team Navi’s Product Team builds solutions that are simple, scalable, and centered on real user needs. The team strongly collaborates across functions—engineering, design, data, and business—to turn insight into impact. About the Role This role provides an opportunity for individuals with a foundational understanding of product analysis to contribute to data-driven decision-making and play a vital role in shaping the success of our products. The Product Analyst will work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and contribute to the overall product strategy. What We Expect From You Gather and analyze data to extract insights, providing valuable input for data-driven decision-making. Use SQL for efficient data querying and analysis. Identify and address product-related issues, relying on established procedures for basic problem-solving. Focus on user insights and data analysis for specific product features. Contribute to the understanding of product performance based on data-driven observations. Demonstrate basic awareness of design principles. Show a sense of good vs. bad design. Pay attention to detail in product analysis. Have basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Understand basic feature prioritization, typically guided by senior product management. Communicate clearly with all stakeholders, seeking help from managers in case of blockers or conflicts. Focus on data analysis and reporting to contribute to decision-making processes. Must Haves 0-2 years of relevant experience in product analysis or a related field. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data. Proficient in SQL for data querying and analysis. Basic understanding of user needs and product features. Basic awareness of design principles and the ability to distinguish good vs. bad design. Basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate findings and insights effectively. About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

Associate Product Manager I Location: Bengaluru About the Team Navi’s Product Team builds solutions that are simple, scalable, and centered on real user needs. The team strongly collaborates across functions—engineering, design, data, and business—to turn insight into impact. About the Role This role provides an opportunity for individuals with a foundational understanding of product analysis to contribute to data-driven decision-making and play a vital role in shaping the success of our products. The Product Analyst will work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and contribute to the overall product strategy. What We Expect From You Gather and analyze data to extract insights, providing valuable input for data-driven decision-making. Use SQL for efficient data querying and analysis. Identify and address product-related issues, relying on established procedures for basic problem-solving. Focus on user insights and data analysis for specific product features. Contribute to the understanding of product performance based on data-driven observations. Demonstrate basic awareness of design principles. Show a sense of good vs. bad design. Pay attention to detail in product analysis. Have basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Understand basic feature prioritization, typically guided by senior product management. Communicate clearly with all stakeholders, seeking help from managers in case of blockers or conflicts. Focus on data analysis and reporting to contribute to decision-making processes. Must Haves 0-2 years of relevant experience in product analysis or a related field. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather, analyze, and interpret data. Proficient in SQL for data querying and analysis. Basic understanding of user needs and product features. Basic awareness of design principles and the ability to distinguish good vs. bad design. Basic familiarity with relevant technology, including REST and database basics. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate findings and insights effectively. About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

As a Data Scientist I at Navi, the candidate will be responsible for developing and deploying scalable data science and AI-driven solutions across financial services, including lending, insurance, investments, UPI, collections, KYC and recommendation systems. The role involves end-to-end ownership of data science projects, from identifying business problems and building machine learning models to deployment, validation, monitoring and performance optimisation. Candidates will work with structured and unstructured data, including tabular, text, image and speech data, applying techniques in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Speech Recognition and Generative AI. Responsibilities also include exploring new algorithms, conducting experiments, extracting actionable insights and collaborating with Product, Engineering and Business teams to develop solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

Software Engineer I Location: Bangalore About Navi We are shaping the future of financial services for a billion Indians through products that are simple, accessible, and affordable. From Personal & Home Loans to UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds, and Gold - we’re building tech-first solutions that work at scale, with a strong customer-first approach. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact. About the Role At Navi, our technology teams build innovative, scalable and intelligent financial products. We leverage software engineering, data science, machine learning and artificial intelligence to solve complex problems across financial services. As an Engineer at Navi, you will solve real-world problems, build technology at scale and develop solutions that deliver measurable customer and business impact. Engineering team at Navi works across following areas: Software Engineering: Build & test scalable applications, backend services, world class Apps, UIs, APIs and distributed systems that delivers Navi's products to customers for powering 4 Billion transactions a month and growing by ~20% month on month. Data Science & Machine Learning: Apply advanced techniques across machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision and Generative AI to solve complex business problems using diverse data. Develop predictive models and intelligent solutions, experiment with emerging approaches, and ensure robust model validation, production monitoring and continuous improvement. GenAI: Build innovative AI-powered applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and agentic AI to develop intelligent chatbots, automate complex workflows and solve real-world business problems. Experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate across teams and deliver scalable, reliable AI solutions that drive meaningful customer and business impact. Data & ML Platforms: Build scalable, cost-efficient infrastructure to collect, process and analyse data through batch and real-time pipelines, enabling self-serve capabilities across Analytics, Data Science and Product. Develop core ML infrastructure, including feature stores, automated training, model serving and real-time monitoring, alongside standalone feature-extraction applications that power Navi’s core technology. What We Expect From You Build and Deliver: Design scalable systems, develop, test and deploy high-quality technology solutions to solve real-world problems. Solve Complex Problems: Apply strong analytical thinking, engineering fundamentals and data-driven approaches to translate ambiguous problems into effective solutions. Explore and Innovate: Experiment with algorithms, architectures and emerging technologies across Software Engineering, Data Science, MLOps, Data Engineering and GenAI. Own End-to-End Outcomes: Take accountability from problem definition and solution design through deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. Collaborate and Learn: Work effectively across teams, exchange ideas, incorporate feedback and continuously strengthen your technical skills. Focus on Impact: Deliver solutions that improve customer experience, system performance, model effectiveness and business outcomes, while upholding the Navi OS. Must Haves Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline. Strong programming fundamentals, proficiency in at least one programming language, and a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to break down complex problems, debug effectively, and develop clean, efficient and maintainable solutions. Strong learning agility, communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to take ownership and adapt to new technologies.

Business Analyst I Location: Bangalore About the Team The Analytics team at Navi plays a pivotal role in driving data-informed decision-making across the organization. We work closely with all business functions to generate insights, build visibility, and validate hypotheses that shape strategy and execution. Our work spans five key verticals: Business and Product Analytics, Credit & Credit Risk Analytics, Collections & Biz-fin Analytics, Self-Serve and Automation. About the Role As a Business Analyst, you will be at the intersection of data, business, and technology—working closely with Operations, Product, and Program leaders to transform raw data into meaningful insights that drive strategic decisions. By analyzing large datasets, identifying trends, and uncovering root causes, you will generate insights that improve processes, enhance customer experience, and drive growth. The role goes beyond preparing reports—you will work directly with business leaders to answer key questions, evaluate opportunities, and recommend actions that deliver measurable impact. With strong problem-solving skills, business acumen, and data-driven thinking, you will help the organization make smarter, faster, and more effective decisions. Key Responsibilities Data Collection, Validation & Analysis – Uncovering trends and correlations through mining and analysis to develop insights, and analyze trends, patterns, and root causes to generate actionable insights. Reporting, Visualization & GenAI Applications – Develop and maintain standardized and ad-hoc reports, dashboards, and visualizations. Leverage GenAI-powered tools to simplify complex analyses, accelerate reporting, and present data in intuitive formats for faster decision-making. Business Consulting & Collaboration – Partner with Product, Ops, Finance, Compliance, and Engineering teams to bridge business goals with customer needs, provide data-backed recommendations, and influence strategic initiatives. Process Improvement & Automation – Continuously identify opportunities to streamline, simplify, and automate redundant processes, enhancing efficiency and scalability in a dynamic fintech environment. Data Governance & Compliance – Ensure adherence to data governance policies and regulatory requirements while handling sensitive information, maintaining accuracy, consistency, and security in reporting. Must Haves Analytical Problem-Solving – Ability to break down complex business problems into structured, solvable components and identify the right approach to address them. Statistical Foundations – Conceptual understanding of basic statistical concepts such as sampling, distributions, measures of central tendency, and hypothesis testing. Business Acumen – Awareness of fundamental business concepts like revenue, cost, margin, and funnel metrics, with the ability to link data insights to business impact. Communication & Collaboration – Strong written and verbal communication skills to present insights clearly and work effectively with cross-functional teams. (Good to Have) Data Handling Skills – Comfort with identifying, extracting, and validating relevant data using tools like SQL and Excel to solve business problems and test hypotheses. Job Description
Business Analyst I Location: Bangalore About the Team The Analytics team at Navi plays a pivotal role in driving data-informed decision-making across the organization. We work closely with all business functions to generate insights, build visibility, and validate hypotheses that shape strategy and execution. Our work spans five key verticals: Business and Product Analytics, Credit & Credit Risk Analytics, Collections & Biz-fin Analytics, Self-Serve and Automation. About the Role As a Business Analyst, you will be at the intersection of data, business, and technology—working closely with Operations, Product, and Program leaders to transform raw data into meaningful insights that drive strategic decisions. By analyzing large datasets, identifying trends, and uncovering root causes, you will generate insights that improve processes, enhance customer experience, and drive growth. The role goes beyond preparing reports—you will work directly with business leaders to answer key questions, evaluate opportunities, and recommend actions that deliver measurable impact. With strong problem-solving skills, business acumen, and data-driven thinking, you will help the organization make smarter, faster, and more effective decisions. Key Responsibilities Data Collection, Validation & Analysis – Uncovering trends and correlations through mining and analysis to develop insights, and analyze trends, patterns, and root causes to generate actionable insights. Reporting, Visualization & GenAI Applications – Develop and maintain standardized and ad-hoc reports, dashboards, and visualizations. Leverage GenAI-powered tools to simplify complex analyses, accelerate reporting, and present data in intuitive formats for faster decision-making. Business Consulting & Collaboration – Partner with Product, Ops, Finance, Compliance, and Engineering teams to bridge business goals with customer needs, provide data-backed recommendations, and influence strategic initiatives. Process Improvement & Automation – Continuously identify opportunities to streamline, simplify, and automate redundant processes, enhancing efficiency and scalability in a dynamic fintech environment. Data Governance & Compliance – Ensure adherence to data governance policies and regulatory requirements while handling sensitive information, maintaining accuracy, consistency, and security in reporting. Must Haves Analytical Problem-Solving – Ability to break down complex business problems into structured, solvable components and identify the right approach to address them. Statistical Foundations – Conceptual understanding of basic statistical concepts such as sampling, distributions, measures of central tendency, and hypothesis testing. Business Acumen – Awareness of fundamental business concepts like revenue, cost, margin, and funnel metrics, with the ability to link data insights to business impact. Communication & Collaboration – Strong written and verbal communication skills to present insights clearly and work effectively with cross-functional teams. (Good to Have) Data Handling Skills – Comfort with identifying, extracting, and validating relevant data using tools like SQL and Excel to solve business problems and test hypotheses. About Navi We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started! Our Culture At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference. We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day. If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

Job Description
We at Pine Labs are looking for those who share our core belief - “Every Day is Game Day”. We bring our best selves to work each day to realize our mission of enriching the world through the power of digital commerce and financial services. ROLE PURPOSE We are hiring for the role of Software Engineer. This is an Individual Contributor role reporting into the Senior Engineering Manager. In your role, you'll be instrumental in advancing our mission by delivering on the end-to-end application, functionality and features as per the project requirements and priorities. You will also be entrusted with ensuring that every feature and functionality of the application is designed, developed, and integrated according to the specified goals and timeline. The responsibilities we entrust you with • Understand the design and project architecture and perform coding and unit testing in accordance with the design and architecture • Understand the issues being reported, analyse the logs and resolve the technical issues through debugging and root cause analysis. • Analyse the trends in issues being reported and troubleshoot issues to determine depth of issues and severity, investigate potential workarounds and take required actions as per defined SLAs • Work with testing team to review test cases, explore opportunities for automation • Document code consistently, analysis findings and benchmark performance as per defined standards • Provide support in the maintenance of test automation scripts and enhancing existing automation scripts to cover the new functionalities WHAT MATTERS IN THIS ROLE • Years of work experience: 0-2 years of experience in software development, including internships. • Qualification: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science (CSE), Information Technology (IT) Experience with Web Services: Consuming or creating web services using REST, MQTT, or Web Sockets. Containerization: Working knowledge of Docker, Rocket, and container orchestrators like Kubernetes and Docker Swarm. Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud services and resources in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Programming and Design: Strong understanding of SOA, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and multi-threaded application development. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP): Understanding of basic concepts such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Ability to implement simple class structures and relationships. Data Structures (DS) & Algorithms: Familiarity with fundamental data structures like arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and basic operations (insertion, deletion, traversal). Source Code Management: Proficiency in Git or similar distributed SCM tools. WHAT WE VALUE IN OUR PEOPLE : You are the CEO of what you do: You show ownership and make things happen. You own tomorrow: You build solutions for the merchants and do the right thing. You sign your work like an artist: You seek to learn and take pride in the work you do.

We specialize in developing these automated trading strategies based on continuous research being done drawing from the concepts of machine learning, financial engineering and derivatives pricing theory. The company is one of the fastest growing high frequency trading firms in India and has a significant market share in Indian cash and derivatives markets. The company looks forward to expanding into global markets as well. With a startup-like spirit and a stability of an experienced firm, we, at Plutus Research, offer you a unique opportunity where you can advance your career with limitless possibilities of learning and growing in the field of quantitative research, trading and low latency infrastructure development.

About the company	Plutus Research is an algorithmic trading firm with sophisticated trading algorithms built on advanced mathematical techniques at its heart. We specialize in developing these automated trading strategies based on continuous research being done drawing from the concepts of machine learning, financial engineering and derivatives pricing theory. The company is one of the fastest growing high frequency trading firms in India and has a significant market share in Indian cash and derivatives markets. The company looks forward to expanding into global markets as well. With a startup-like spirit and a stability of an experienced firm, we, at Plutus Research, offer you a unique opportunity where you can advance your career with limitless possibilities of learning and growing in the field of quantitative research, trading and low latency infrastructure development.

companies.description:
About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje (IIT Bombay CSE 2008) https://youtu.be/za0YpZxcWsA?si=7mQ6fn0pcy3sR-7z *About The Team* You’ll join Prodigal’s Consulting team. We partner with creditors in consumer finance (banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies) to transform how they engage with consumers using data-driven insights and AI-agents. The team sits at the intersection of product, data science, and client operations: designing strategy, building execution pipelines, and running experiments that deliver measurable lifts business operations. *The role* Most consulting ends with a recommendation. Here, that’s where your work starts. In this role, you own business outcomes for our clients. You get to the root of the problem, strategize & design the solution, put it into production and keep improving it until the numbers move. You’ll work with client CXOs, alongside our data science and engineering teams, and you’ll see the real impact of your work. *What you’ll do* Diagnose: Understand how a client’s business actually runs and find where the biggest opportunity lies. Strategize: Turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and solutions, using data and first-principles thinking. Deploy: Take solutions from idea to live execution, working with internal teams and client stakeholders. Drive results: Track performance, experiment, iterate and scale what works. Advise: Become a trusted advisor to client leadership on what’s best for their business. *What you get* End-to-end ownership from day one Direct exposure to CXOs at US enterprises Periodic travel to the US for client meetings and industry conferences A fast-track path to a Lead role, based on your performance and how quickly you learn *Who we’re looking for* Any discipline, with strong analytical ability A structured thinker who enjoys messy, ambiguous problems A clear communicator, comfortable with senior stakeholders High ownership, with a bias for getting things done Interested in consulting, strategy or how businesses really work Proficiency in Excel, Python, SQL, and Tableau/other BI tools is preferred *Mode of work - 5 days in office* *Evaluation Process :* Intro and communication (15 minutes) Problem/puzzle solving (30 minutes) Case study (60 minutes) Culture fit (20 minutes) *Job Benefits:* World-class team - You'll get the chance to learn from (and teach) some of the brightest and most skilled people you'll ever meet. Our team members have been part of BCG, YCP, Kearney, FSG, Nomura, Deloitte, EY, Blackstone, Meta, Amazon and are IIT, IIM, BITS alumnus. Continuous education - As relentless seekers of knowledge, we sponsor and support any training materials, books, courses, and exam fees for upskilling yourself in areas related to your role - but that's not where it ends. If you make a good case for some extra learning, we're delighted to foot the tab. Food at the office – Meals are on us. We won't let your stomach grumble while you hustle. Health insurance - Health always comes first. The health of your family is as important to us, as it is to you. We offer insurance coverage for both you and your family. Flexible schedule - We're not a "clock in, clock out" company. Morning person? Start work while the world's still sleeping. Night owl? Ramp things up while others are winding down. You're fully trusted to create the right conditions for your own personal peak productivity. We only ask that you be available to your teammates for seamless collaboration. Unlimited leaves - Take all the time you need to recharge your batteries - no cap on vacation allowance here. Because a rested, relaxed, and refreshed mind is a happy and effective mind. Recreation & team activities – We regularly indulge in friendly football, table tennis, cooking sessions and challenge each other to do those extra push ups or chug that 4th drink (of course that’s Nimbu Pani)

Job Description
About Prodigal Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations. We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time. These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved? Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them. Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America. Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next. We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect. We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje (IIT Bombay CSE 2008) https://youtu.be/za0YpZxcWsA?si=7mQ6fn0pcy3sR-7z *About The Team* You’ll join Prodigal’s Consulting team. We partner with creditors in consumer finance (banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies) to transform how they engage with consumers using data-driven insights and AI-agents. The team sits at the intersection of product, data science, and client operations: designing strategy, building execution pipelines, and running experiments that deliver measurable lifts business operations. *The role* Most consulting ends with a recommendation. Here, that’s where your work starts. In this role, you own business outcomes for our clients. You get to the root of the problem, strategize & design the solution, put it into production and keep improving it until the numbers move. You’ll work with client CXOs, alongside our data science and engineering teams, and you’ll see the real impact of your work. *What you’ll do* Diagnose: Understand how a client’s business actually runs and find where the biggest opportunity lies. Strategize: Turn ambiguous problems into clear strategies and solutions, using data and first-principles thinking. Deploy: Take solutions from idea to live execution, working with internal teams and client stakeholders. Drive results: Track performance, experiment, iterate and scale what works. Advise: Become a trusted advisor to client leadership on what’s best for their business. *What you get* End-to-end ownership from day one Direct exposure to CXOs at US enterprises Periodic travel to the US for client meetings and industry conferences A fast-track path to a Lead role, based on your performance and how quickly you learn *Who we’re looking for* Any discipline, with strong analytical ability A structured thinker who enjoys messy, ambiguous problems A clear communicator, comfortable with senior stakeholders High ownership, with a bias for getting things done Interested in consulting, strategy or how businesses really work Proficiency in Excel, Python, SQL, and Tableau/other BI tools is preferred *Mode of work - 5 days in office* *Evaluation Process :* Intro and communication (15 minutes) Problem/puzzle solving (30 minutes) Case study (60 minutes) Culture fit (20 minutes) *Job Benefits:* World-class team - You'll get the chance to learn from (and teach) some of the brightest and most skilled people you'll ever meet. Our team members have been part of BCG, YCP, Kearney, FSG, Nomura, Deloitte, EY, Blackstone, Meta, Amazon and are IIT, IIM, BITS alumnus. Continuous education - As relentless seekers of knowledge, we sponsor and support any training materials, books, courses, and exam fees for upskilling yourself in areas related to your role - but that's not where it ends. If you make a good case for some extra learning, we're delighted to foot the tab. Food at the office – Meals are on us. We won't let your stomach grumble while you hustle. Health insurance - Health always comes first. The health of your family is as important to us, as it is to you. We offer insurance coverage for both you and your family. Flexible schedule - We're not a "clock in, clock out" company. Morning person? Start work while the world's still sleeping. Night owl? Ramp things up while others are winding down. You're fully trusted to create the right conditions for your own personal peak productivity. We only ask that you be available to your teammates for seamless collaboration. Unlimited leaves - Take all the time you need to recharge your batteries - no cap on vacation allowance here. Because a rested, relaxed, and refreshed mind is a happy and effective mind. Recreation & team activities – We regularly indulge in friendly football, table tennis, cooking sessions and challenge each other to do those extra push ups or chug that 4th drink (of course that’s Nimbu Pani)

companies.description:
SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited Engineer, R&D (Rnd-SysE-AppE-CSA-COE) The job profile has multiple tracks: 1. R&D track (candidate is involved in “proof of concepts” for new technology development) 2. Systems engineering track (candidate is product owners involved in designing products that go into production, especially for new product lines) 3. Applications engineering track (the role is like systems engineering, but more relevant for scaling existing product lines to high volumes) 4. Control systems architect track (candidate works on writing control-intensive software that goes into production) 5. Center of Excellence track (candidate focuses on engineering verticals such as FEA / CFD simulations) All tracks will follow a common selection procedure, including a common written test. Once selected, the candidate will be assigned one of the above tracks based on the candidate's interests and the candidate's performance in the written tests and interviews. About the job The candidate is expected to participate in building technologies and products for automotive & off-highway powertrains such that the built products and technologies are deployed in large numbers world-wide. S/he is expected build technology differentiators and/or well-engineered robust products and work with a cross functional team to execute the same. Major Responsibilities The candidate will work on creating technology differentiators and/or robust in domains such as engine controls, motor controls, battery technology, electric machines and inertial measurement systems. The candidate will also likely have to lead a team of engineers depending on the nature of problem statement / product line assigned to the candidate. Depending on the track the candidate is assigned when the candidate joins SEDEMAC, the candidate’s day-to-day job will be a suitable subset of the below activities: • Develop a first principles understanding of the physics behind systems being considered; examples of systems being electric machines, IMUs, buck-boost converters, flux sensors, parasitic inductances of PCBs etc. • Mathematically model the system; design and conduct experiments to validate the hypothesized mathematical model. • Develop "methods/ strategies / circuits" to control / observe the system for desirable behaviour / insights. About the team Be it huge, medium, small, tiny, micro - every decision falls under the eyes of our Analytics team. Every analysis and insight drawn by the Analytics team directly impacts our business without fail and that's why the team is full of people who make sure the impact’s legen - wait for it - dary - Legendary. If digging into numbers and unlocking insights sounds like your kind of fun, you’ll fit right in. About the role As an Analyst at slice, you’ll turn data into decisions. You’ll work with teams across Product, Growth, Credit, and Leadership to uncover insights, solve real business problems, and drive strategy. If you’re excited about using data to fuel impact at scale, this role is for you. What You will do You'll start with first principles thinking - breaking down problems to their core, using data and analytical reasoning to uncover insights that really move the needle for the business and create a better experience for our customers. You'll get hands-on across the analytics spectrum: Descriptive – building clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards Diagnostic – digging into the why behind trends and performance Prescriptive – turning insights into recommendations that drive smart decisions You’ll work side-by-side with functional leaders and business partners across teams like Growth, Retention, Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing Fraud, and Ops, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and helping define the real business problems worth solving. And most importantly, you’ll turn complex data into simple, actionable stories - crafting solutions that power big decisions and deliver real impact at scale. What you will need Hustle + Heart: You’ve got the drive to build data solutions that touch millions of lives and the curiosity to keep asking “what’s next?” You speak data fluently: Advanced SQL is your second language, and you’re comfortable in Python, R, or Excel when the situation calls for it. Problem-solving at your core: You love breaking big, messy problems into bite-sized pieces - and crafting smart, scalable solutions. Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas crisply High ownership mindset and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal hand-holding Life at slice Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: Competitive salaries. Period. An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”. Come join our crew! About us slice the way you bank slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, slice UPI ATMs, slice fixed deposits, slice borrow, and UPI-powered bank branch are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together. We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

About the team Be it huge, medium, small, tiny, micro - every decision falls under the eyes of our Analytics team. Every analysis and insight drawn by the Analytics team directly impacts our business without fail and that's why the team is full of people who make sure the impact’s legen - wait for it - dary - Legendary. If digging into numbers and unlocking insights sounds like your kind of fun, you’ll fit right in. About the role As an Analyst at slice, you’ll turn data into decisions. You’ll work with teams across Product, Growth, Credit, and Leadership to uncover insights, solve real business problems, and drive strategy. If you’re excited about using data to fuel impact at scale, this role is for you. What You will do You'll start with first principles thinking - breaking down problems to their core, using data and analytical reasoning to uncover insights that really move the needle for the business and create a better experience for our customers. You'll get hands-on across the analytics spectrum: Descriptive – building clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards Diagnostic – digging into the why behind trends and performance Prescriptive – turning insights into recommendations that drive smart decisions You’ll work side-by-side with functional leaders and business partners across teams like Growth, Retention, Product, Risk, Engineering, Marketing Fraud, and Ops, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions, and helping define the real business problems worth solving. And most importantly, you’ll turn complex data into simple, actionable stories - crafting solutions that power big decisions and deliver real impact at scale. What you will need Hustle + Heart: You’ve got the drive to build data solutions that touch millions of lives and the curiosity to keep asking “what’s next?” You speak data fluently: Advanced SQL is your second language, and you’re comfortable in Python, R, or Excel when the situation calls for it. Problem-solving at your core: You love breaking big, messy problems into bite-sized pieces - and crafting smart, scalable solutions. Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas crisply High ownership mindset and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal hand-holding Life at slice Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: Competitive salaries. Period. An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”. Come join our crew! About us slice the way you bank slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, slice UPI ATMs, slice fixed deposits, slice borrow, and UPI-powered bank branch are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together. We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors, including Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Advent International, Blume Ventures, and Gunosy Capital.

Job Description
About the team: Are you fascinated with building a problem-solving, customer-facing, intuitive, creative tech-products that adds value to their life? Well, if you’ve landed on this page, your answer is most-likely YES. Visionary, cynical, upskilling - a few adjectives to describe our Product team. If you feel the vibe, step 1 is done. About the role: As an Associate Product Manager, you’ll work at the intersection of product, analytics, and execution. You’ll help break down real-world payment problems, turn data into insights, and support the building of simple, intuitive experiences used by millions of young Indians. This role is perfect if you’re excited about learning product craft, using data to guide decisions, and shipping features that create visible impact. What You will do: - Work closely with Product Managers to understand customer problems, business goals, and stakeholder requirements - Turn raw data into sharp insights that shape what gets built next - Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with data, metrics, dashboards, and basic SQL/Excel. - Help write the requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that turn ideas into shipped features - Bring structure to roadmap conversations, blending gut instinct with hard numbers - Work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and analytics to take features from whiteboard to millions of screens - Own the post-launch story - track what worked, what didn't, and why, then use that to make the next version sharper - Develop a deep understanding of how users interact with slice products and where we can make experiences simpler and better What you will need: - Strong first-principles and structured problem-solving ability - you'd rather break a problem down from scratch than reach for a template - Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate ideas crisply - High ownership mindset and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal hand-holding - Prior internship experience in product management, analytics, consulting, or related roles is a plus - Genuine curiosity about how India spends, saves, and borrows Life at slice Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding: - Competitive salaries. Period. - An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise. - Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule. - Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life. - A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here. - Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding. - Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel at home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”. Come join our crew! About slice: slice A new bank for a new India slice’s purpose is to make the world better at using money and time, with a major focus on building the best consumer experience for your money. We’ve all felt how slow, confusing, and complicated banking can be. So, we’re reimagining it. We’re building every product from scratch to be fast, transparent, and feel good, because we believe that the best products transcend demographics, like how great music touches most of us. Our cornerstone products and services: slice savings account, slice UPI credit card, slice UPI, slice UPI ATMs, slice fixed deposits, slice borrow, and UPI-powered bank branch are designed to be simple, rewarding, and completely in your control. At slice, you’ll get to build things you’d use yourself and shape the future of banking in India. We tailor our working experience with the belief that the present moment is the only real thing in life. And we have harmony in the present the most when we feel happy and successful together.

companies.description:
We are looking for highly motivated graduates or early career professionals with an interest in finance and a background in computer science, engineering, mathematics or other STEM degrees to join our Desk Quant Analyst three-year program. You will spend these three years working in close collaboration with experienced Quantitative Researchers and Traders to understand the constantly evolving needs of the trading desks. | Overview of Desk Quant Analyst Position: • Maintain and upgrade the codebase and configuration of strategies within the firm’s automated trading framework. • Manage large datasets used in both research and production environments. • Perform live as well as historical monitoring of trading activities. For instance, do some post-trade analysis or production reconciliation. • Work in close collaboration with quant researchers and traders to understand the constantly evolving needs of the trading desks. Typical Day of Desk Quant Analyst • Before market open, check that all required data and related processes are ready for the trading day. • During market hours, sporadically monitor behavior and performance of strategies. • Work on various longer-term projects required for expanding our systematic trading activities and ensuring their robustness.

companies.description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. Our Quantitative Researchers are embedded within the following teams: Alpha Researcher: As a member of the Alpha Researcher team, you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. Data Scientist: As a member of the Data Science team, you will be involved in parsing and analyzing large data sets, working on discovering and obtaining new sources of data and collaborating with the Alpha and Strategy team to build predictive machine learning models. Strategy Researcher: As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. The data you train and validate comes from actual market trading When you apply for a Quantitative Researcher role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Quantitative Researcher. During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best research team that closely aligns with your skills and preference. Your Responsibilities: Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals Parse data sets to be used for future alpha(strategy) development Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance Collaborate with experienced and resourceful quantitative researchers to carry out experiments and test hypothesis using simulations Requirements Graduate degree (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) in any STEM discipline from a prestigious institution Passion for machine learning and quantitative finance Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player Proficient in programming languages such as Python Previous experience in alpha research and the development of trading signals and strategies The role is also open for candidates graduating from Tier 1 campuses in 2027 Benefits Competitive compensation with bonus tied to the performance of algorithms you develop Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in decision-making process for research direction, and have opportunity to lead on new ideas Pre-tax commuter benefits Weekly company meals

Strategy Researcher: As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. About the company	Trexquant has continuously improved its investment and research platform since starting operations in April 2014. Our firm was founded on the principles of traditional quantitative finance. However, our commitment to leveraging new and emerging technologies, particularly machine learning and data science, has enabled us to stand out in the industry today. We use rigorous quantitative methods with the objective of creating market-neutral equity portfolios in global equity markets. To do this, we develop trading signals (or Alphas) using our vast and continuously growing collection of data variables. Our proprietary backtesting platform helps us refine these signals until we’re confident they’re ready for production. The strategy team then uses the Alphas as inputs for more complex trading models called Strategies. The result is an ever-growing and adapting engine built from thousands of intricate models and tens of thousands of signals, tailor-made and continuously engineered to outperform and seek profit from the market in all market conditions.
