Job Description
Senior Category Manager Own a category's operations across a set of cities. No two days look the same. What you'll do Drive operational excellence for your cities — selecting, onboarding and training new service partners, and improving the quality of existing ones. This is the core of the role and it is operations-heavy. Take on central growth tracks for the category over time: service quality, new offerings, innovation. Partner with cross-functional teams to execute quickly and reliably. Own the business entrusted to you. Your calls directly shape how it grows. What we're looking for Demonstrated leadership of teams and projects, and the ability to influence without authority. A high ownership mindset and genuine interest in operational detail. People who know great things get built through both smarts and hard work. What you get Real ownership from day one, close work with some of the country's strongest operations leaders, and internal mobility across UC. ● Build & Reimagine: Participate in designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining high-quality, scalable backend services, APIs, and data processing pipelines. ● Full Lifecycle Ownership: Own features through the complete development lifecycle—from early design discussions and code creation to testing, deployment, and ongoing operational maintenance. ● Data Platform Architecture: Contribute to building and maintaining high-availability dimensional data stores, reverse-ETL processes, and analytical serving layers powering core business tracking, trend analysis, and AI applications. ● Operational Excellence: Apply software engineering best practices including unit/integration testing, monitoring, logging, and performance debugging to ensure system reliability and low latency. ● Global Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams in Bangalore and North America to align on architecture, processes, and delivery objectives. ● Continuous Growth: Learn and master the craft of software engineering through code reviews, technical mentorship, and active participation in a culture of continuous learning. ● Computer Science The role will entail working closely with the investment research team. You will be part of the entire investment process, beginning with idea generation, company evaluation, management meetings, channel checks and valuations. You will be working as part of sector teams covering designated sectors basis candidate preference/ firm requirements. As a part of the sector/ company specific research, you would be the part of the end-to-end investment process which would include, but not limited to: a) Idea generation: Identifying investable opportunities basis quantitative and qualitative factors b) Company Evaluation: Understanding the business model, growth drivers, competitive strengths, management capabilities and capital allocation, amongst others, to build an investment thesis c) Industry Analysis: Delineating market dynamics and structures, along with sectoral trends d) Stakeholder meetings: Participating actively in management, industry expert meetings/ conferences to generate actionable insights e) Due diligence and Channel Checks: Visiting relevant plants/ stores/ markets to improve on business understanding f) Financial Analysis: Analysing financial statements and building/ maintaining financial models, including proprietary models, for coverage companies g) Portfolio Tracking: Periodic tracking the business progress of coverage companies to monitor progress of investment thesis h) Research Discussions: Active participation in internal research discussions on ideas across the relevant investment universe Candidates are expected to pursue higher studies post the completion of the 2-year program. Exceptional performers in the program may be considered for a permanent role.

About the company	WhiteOak Capital group provides investment management and advisory services for equity assets of over USD 12 Bn as of June 2026, across the group. Besides segregated managed accounts for leading global institutions, WhiteOak offers investment services through a wide array of fund vehicles domiciled in India, Ireland, Mauritius, and UK to individual and institutional investors in India and worldwide. WhiteOak has investment research teams based in India, Singapore, and Spain, and additional sales and distribution offices across Asia and Europe. WhiteOak Capital group was founded by Mr. Prashant Khemka, former CIO of Goldman Sachs Asset Management’s India Equity and Global Emerging Markets Equity businesses. WhiteOak’s performance-first investment culture is founded upon the following four pillars; stock selection-based philosophy, high caliber research team, disciplined analytical process and balanced portfolio construction framework. Recently, White Oak has also launched 2 new initiatives – Global Emerging Markets (GEM) practice, covering over 40 emerging market economies, and a domestic Asset Management Company (AMC) business.

Job Description
The role will entail working closely with the investment research team. You will be part of the entire investment process, beginning with idea generation, company evaluation, management meetings, channel checks and valuations. You will be working as part of sector teams covering designated sectors basis candidate preference/ firm requirements. As a part of the sector/ company specific research, you would be the part of the end-to-end investment process which would include, but not limited to: a) Idea generation: Identifying investable opportunities basis quantitative and qualitative factors b) Company Evaluation: Understanding the business model, growth drivers, competitive strengths, management capabilities and capital allocation, amongst others, to build an investment thesis c) Industry Analysis: Delineating market dynamics and structures, along with sectoral trends d) Stakeholder meetings: Participating actively in management, industry expert meetings/ conferences to generate actionable insights e) Due diligence and Channel Checks: Visiting relevant plants/ stores/ markets to improve on business understanding f) Financial Analysis: Analysing financial statements and building/ maintaining financial models, including proprietary models, for coverage companies g) Portfolio Tracking: Periodic tracking the business progress of coverage companies to monitor progress of investment thesis h) Research Discussions: Active participation in internal research discussions on ideas across the relevant investment universe Candidates are expected to pursue higher studies post the completion of the 2-year program. companies.description:
Infrastructure Developer Low-Latency Systems — HFT Technology About the role As an Infrastructure Developer on Zanskar Research's HFT Technology team, you will architect and engineer the ultra-low-latency trading stack that gives our strategies a measurable edge - measured in microseconds and nanoseconds. You will work at the intersection of systems programming, networking, and financial markets, solving some of the most technically demanding engineering problems in the industry. Key responsibilities — Design and develop low-latency order management systems (OMS) and execution infrastructure in C++ (17/20). — Build and optimise kernel-bypass networking components using DPDK, RDMA, or FPGA-based feed handlers for market data ingestion. — Implement and tune exchange connectivity (FIX, ITCH, OUCH, NSE/BSE native protocols) with nanosecond-precision timestamping. — Build and maintain automated testing pipelines including market simulation environments and replay-based regression testing. — Collaborate with quant researchers to deploy new strategies into production with safe, observable rollout processes. — Own reliability and observability: design alerting, circuit breakers, kill-switches, and real-time telemetry dashboards. — Continuously evaluate and integrate new hardware and software technologies to improve throughput and reduce jitter. Required qualifications — Currently pursuing a B.Tech / Dual Degree / M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline - with a strong academic record. — Strong C++ proficiency (STL, templates, move semantics, memory model) with a clear understanding of performance implications of language constructs. — Deep knowledge of Linux internals: process/thread scheduling, memory subsystems, system calls, and kernel networking. — Solid understanding of CPU microarchitecture: cache hierarchy, branch prediction, instruction pipelining, SIMD. — Competence in data structures and algorithms - ability to reason about time and space complexity at a hardware level. Good to have — Hands-on exposure to HFT or real-time systems (internship, project, or personal work). — Familiarity with FPGA programming (VHDL/Verilog) or SmartNIC offload pipelines. — Knowledge of exchange market data protocols: ITCH, PITCH, FAST, or NSE/BSE proprietary feeds. — Proficiency in Python for tooling, test automation, and monitoring scripts. What we offer — Access to cutting-edge hardware: co-located servers, 10G/25G NICs, FPGA cards, and dedicated testing environments. — Work on problems where every microsecond genuinely matters - no artificial constraints or bureaucratic bottlenecks. — Rapid ownership: new hires own a production system component within their first 60 days. — Strong engineering culture with regular internal tech talks and hardware deep-dives.(Codeforces/AtCoder 1500+ rating or Codechef 1700+ rating) eligible

Job Description
Infrastructure Developer Low-Latency Systems — HFT Technology About the role As an Infrastructure Developer on Zanskar Research's HFT Technology team, you will architect and engineer the ultra-low-latency trading stack that gives our strategies a measurable edge - measured in microseconds and nanoseconds. You will work at the intersection of systems programming, networking, and financial markets, solving some of the most technically demanding engineering problems in the industry. Key responsibilities — Design and develop low-latency order management systems (OMS) and execution infrastructure in C++ (17/20). — Build and optimise kernel-bypass networking components using DPDK, RDMA, or FPGA-based feed handlers for market data ingestion. — Implement and tune exchange connectivity (FIX, ITCH, OUCH, NSE/BSE native protocols) with nanosecond-precision timestamping. — Build and maintain automated testing pipelines including market simulation environments and replay-based regression testing. — Collaborate with quant researchers to deploy new strategies into production with safe, observable rollout processes. — Own reliability and observability: design alerting, circuit breakers, kill-switches, and real-time telemetry dashboards. — Continuously evaluate and integrate new hardware and software technologies to improve throughput and reduce jitter. Required qualifications — Currently pursuing a B.Tech / Dual Degree / M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline - with a strong academic record. — Strong C++ proficiency (STL, templates, move semantics, memory model) with a clear understanding of performance implications of language constructs. — Deep knowledge of Linux internals: process/thread scheduling, memory subsystems, system calls, and kernel networking. — Solid understanding of CPU microarchitecture: cache hierarchy, branch prediction, instruction pipelining, SIMD. — Competence in data structures and algorithms - ability to reason about time and space complexity at a hardware level. Good to have — Hands-on exposure to HFT or real-time systems (internship, project, or personal work). — Familiarity with FPGA programming (VHDL/Verilog) or SmartNIC offload pipelines. — Knowledge of exchange market data protocols: ITCH, PITCH, FAST, or NSE/BSE proprietary feeds. — Proficiency in Python for tooling, test automation, and monitoring scripts. What we offer — Access to cutting-edge hardware: co-located servers, 10G/25G NICs, FPGA cards, and dedicated testing environments. — Work on problems where every microsecond genuinely matters - no artificial constraints or bureaucratic bottlenecks. — Rapid ownership: new hires own a production system component within their first 60 days. — Strong engineering culture with regular internal tech talks and hardware deep-dives.(Codeforces/AtCoder 1500+ rating or Codechef 1700+ rating) eligible
